caption: The drawing shows a man and a bear as sculpted, figurine-like objects. The man stands on the left, facing right, wearing brown pants, a brown jacket, a yellowish-brown hat, and dark shoes. He has a light-colored face and hands, glasses or spectacles, and a blue shirt or vest under his jacket. He is holding a large gray double-barreled gun pointed to the right. The bear is brown and appears from the waist up, emerging from a hollow tree stump on the right side of the image. The tree stump is a textured brown with yellow accents at its base and has a hinged lid open, revealing the bear. The background is a plain off-white or cream color. Engraved or painted near the bottom of the base is the text "TELL IT TO THE BEAR." The artist's name, Pearl Torell, is written in small letters on the lower right side.
title: Toy Bank: "Teddy and the Bear"
